test_case.purpose: Sustain the approved FurMark/OpenGL workload for eight continuous hours with verified 4K internal render and physical output, while trending GPU/platform health and periodically proving link and visible-pixel stability under an independently recoverable watchdog.
required_package: Approved FurMark 1.29.0.0 artifact/source/license/hash and exact burn-in preset, AA, fullscreen/window and 3840x2160 render settings
Exact Windows/GPU/driver/VBIOS/OpenGL identity plus requested/active/negotiated 3840x2160 refresh, scaling, HDR/color and link data
Approved continuous eight-hour duration, telemetry and visual sampling cadence, score/stability threshold and invalid-run rule
ECC baseline/delta/severity and GPU thermal/power/clock/throttle, driver/reset, display-link and platform-event abort limits
Dedicated cooled window, watchdog/alerting with independent recovery, qualified operator coverage, bounded evidence storage and cooldown plan
test_case.test_command: REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; after approved bindings and execution OK, verify artifact hash, exact GPU/display identity, positive OpenGL support, separate 4K render/active/negotiated modes, baseline ECC/events, evidence capacity, watchdog and recovery path without clearing logs. Launch only the approved FurMark preset for eight continuous hours. Sample GPU/link/BMC/Windows state and physical display evidence at the approved cadence; retain complete result and gap-free timeline. Any interruption, monitor loss or watchdog gap invalidates coverage and is not auto-retried. Stop immediately at any abort limit, then collect final ECC/event deltas and cooldown health.
test_case.expected_result: The approved preset runs uninterrupted for at least eight hours with internal render, active desktop and negotiated physical output all at 3840x2160; telemetry/evidence has no gap, result meets the approved threshold, no hang/reset/disallowed throttle occurs, thermal/power/link and ECC/event trends stay within limits, and every sampled physical observation shows no corruption, flicker, tearing, freeze, scaling/HDR/color or edge artifact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires a gap-free continuous eight-hour run and every 4K layer, score/stability, health, ECC/event, watchdog and sampled visual threshold. Twenty minutes, calibration or summed segments cannot PASS. FAIL on interruption/gap, wrong render/link mode, invalid result, artifact/hang, watchdog/recovery failure, thermal/power/throttle/link/driver limit or unacceptable ECC/event delta. BLOCKED at runtime when any required configuration is absent. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Do not install unapproved artifacts or run sustained FurMark on production; require dedicated cooling/power and independent recovery.
Prove internal 4K render, Windows active mode and physical negotiated link separately; screenshots alone are insufficient.
Preflight evidence capacity and watchdog; preserve complete baseline/delta logs and never clear SEL/Windows/GPU evidence.
Stop on first approved limit or monitoring gap; do not retry, reset or reboot automatically, and record extended cooldown/final health.
expected_evidence: Approved artifact/hash/preset/thresholds, cadence, watchdog/recovery and eight-hour authorization
Exact GPU/driver/OpenGL/display identity plus internal-render, active and negotiated 4K proof
Gap-free timestamped eight-hour timeline and complete FurMark result/validity/score
Periodic thermal/power/clock/throttle/link and complete ECC/SEL/Windows baseline-trend-delta evidence
Periodic physical 4K visual records, watchdog/abort/no-retry/recovery/cooldown audit and end-user verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop FurMark on first limit or monitoring failure, preserve the full partial-run timeline and do not retry. Use the independent approved Windows/console recovery, allow extended cooldown, verify GPU/driver/display/BMC health and restore the approved session without automatic reset/reboot.
